title: film_gls
description: General Linear Model fitting with autocorrelation in FMRI

infile.description: Input data file (NIFTI for volumetric, GIFTI for surface)
infile.title: Input file

threshold.description: Initial threshold to apply to input data
threshold.title: Initial threshold

ar_flag.description: Fits autoregressive model - default is to use tukey with M=sqrt(numvols)
ar_flag.title: Autoregressive model flag

outputPW_flag.description: Output prewhitened data and average design matrix
outputPW_flag.title: Output PW data

pava_flag.description: Estimates autocorrelation using PAVA - default is to use tukey with M=sqrt(numvols)
pava_flag.title: PAVA autocorrelation estimation

results_dir.description: Directory name to store results in, default is results
results_dir.title: Results directory

mode.description: Analysis mode, options are volumetric (default) or surface. Caution: surface-based functionality is still BETA
mode.title: Analysis mode

input_surface.description: Input surface for autocorrelation smoothing in surface-based analyses
input_surface.title: Input surface file

mean_func_file.description: Re-estimate mean_func baseline - for use with perfusion subtraction
mean_func_file.title: Mean function file

epith.description: SUSAN brightness threshold for volumetric analysis/smoothing sigma for surface analysis
epith.title: SUSAN brightness threshold

ms.description: SUSAN mask size for volumetric analysis/smoothing extent for surface analysis
ms.title: SUSAN mask size

tukey.description: Uses tukey window to estimate autocorrelation with window size num - default is to use tukey with M=sqrt(numvols)
tukey.title: Tukey window size

mt.description: Uses multitapering with slepian tapers and num is the time-bandwidth product - default is to use tukey with M=sqrt(numvols)
mt.title: Multitapering time-bandwidth product

ven.description: List of numbers indicating voxelwise EVs position in the design matrix (list order corresponds to files in vxf option). Caution BETA option, only use with volumetric analysis.
ven.title: Voxelwise EVs positions

vef.description: List of 4D images containing voxelwise EVs (list order corresponds to numbers in vxl option). Caution BETA option, only use with volumetric analysis.
vef.title: Voxelwise EVs files
